_source: The GST state code list: the first two digits of a GSTIN name the State or Union Territory of registration (GSTN, as shown on the GST portal https://www.gst.gov.in and in the CBIC GST registration notes). Public data, transcribed 2026-11-23 for the batch 7 address check (AB-220); not fetched from an official page in that session, so it is listed for re-checking against the portal. Used for a WARNING only, never a refusal. 25 (Daman and Diu) is kept for GSTINs issued before the 2020 merger into 26; 28 is Andhra Pradesh before its division, 37 after it. 97 and 99 name no State and never match an address.

26: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
